strategy_rationale: TRD reworks existing commands, hooks and tests. refactor requires tests pass before AND after; 66 pre-existing failures are baselined in test-baseline.txt so the gate blocks on NEW failures only.

All three modules REJECTED as designs; 4 narrow mechanics + 1 algorithm adopted. Clone at $CLAUDE_JOB_DIR/tmp/sunstone/ensemble, git status empty after read.

ITR-P003.evidence: docs/modernization/runs/item8/workflow-probes.md + lead-session probe wf_fcc44fab-e84. ATTESTED: (a) agent() accepts opts.agentType YES; (b) workflow agent CANNOT spawn a subagent -- 'No such tool available: Agent. Agent is disabled for this session, in subagents as well as here' -- so AC-F8.4/NFR-4 unbuildable as written; (c) workflow agent CAN invoke /code-review via Skill, which self-backgrounds. Workflow agents DO have Bash/Read/Write/Edit; they lack Agent, Workflow and all Task tools. NOTE: Workflow is unavailable inside subagents, so this probe must run from the lead session.
